what: Clothesline sagging in the middle (sag = width 3%, max 36px) a few photos pinned with two clips sway like cloth (WebGL) — each photo moves a 12×16 point grid with Verlet integration (damping .982, gravity 1400px/s²), satisfies the horizontal, vertical, and diagonal lengths 6 times each, and ties the top row to the rope. Wind per point is the sum of two sines (2.3·3.7Hz) at 380+520e front-back and 90+60e sideways, multiplied by a slow gust (.55±.45, .45·.23Hz), so it gets stronger toward the bottom. Within the 90px cursor radius, points are pushed back by (1−d/90)² times 700~3300 and dragged sideways by cursor speed (±600)×1.6. Drawn with focal-1600 perspective, front light .62+.42·face tilt, and a 1.5% cloth weave pattern. Stops when off-screen

options.sag: Max sag depth of the line (px), default 36 (or 3% of width, whichever is smaller)
options.data-flags: For each photo { name, label } — Name band text to paint on the cloth and photo slot labels
options.[data-fx-part=canvas]·[data-fx-part=rope: Canvas and line svg to draw on (data-fx-part that holds one path and a clamp=pegs group), photo list (data-fx-part on each li=pic photo slot, data-fx-part=name label)
options.--fx-rope · --fx-peg · --fx-peg-edge: Line, clip and clip rim colors (mixed from the default skin color)

use: • Client
note: The original paints photos onto cloth — the part paints a skin-color base, a diagonal and a label where the photo goes (edit paint to swap in images). Without WebGL the list shows as is. Below 760px only three. With reduced motion, a single still with no wind.
